forbidden: This page is for Puntr admins.

resync.title: Re-sync from the data provider
resync.body: Runs the fixture and result syncs now. It uses calls from the provider's daily quota.
resync.done: Fixtures: {{fcalls}} calls, {{fupserted}} updated. Results: {{rcalls}} calls, {{rupserted}} updated.

error.not_configured: SPORTS_API_KEY is not set on the server.
error.error: The sync failed. Check the server logs.

csv.title: CSV import
csv.body: For fixtures the data provider misses. Every row is checked first; if any row is wrong nothing is imported. Re-importing the same row updates it.
csv.label: CSV

error.invalid: The file has problems. Nothing was imported.
error.error: Something went wrong. Nothing was imported.

title: Admin

settle.title: Settlement
settle.overview: Final matches with picks waiting for a first settlement
settle.none: Nothing is waiting. Picks settle automatically within minutes of a result.
settle.noScore: No score yet: it can't be graded automatically.
settle.error: Could not settle. Check the server logs.

manual.title: Correct or settle a pick
manual.body: A correction is written as a new entry with your reason and name. The earlier entries stay on the record.

reports.title: Reports
reports.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

users.title: Users
users.hideBody: The pick leaves the public feed but stays in the record and in /verify. Write the reason.
users.hideError: Couldn't hide that pick. Check the ID.

waitlist.title: Waitlist
waitlist.empty: The waitlist is empty. The earlier sign-ups still need importing into this project.
waitlist.note: Invites are sent by the script (bun run waitlist:invite), not from here. Do not send until the attorney has agreed the approach.

launch.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.

notice.body: Send this to the early-access list on WhatsApp and SMS today. Personalised one-tap links are on the Waitlist tab.

emails.title: Launch emails
emails.off: Sending is switched off. Set LAUNCH_EMAILS_ENABLED=true on the server when you are ready.
emails.notConfigured: The email service keys are not set on the server.
emails.note: Emails go out at 08:00 on each date (SAST) to people who have not signed up yet, were not unsubscribed and have no privacy request. Reminders 1 and 2 go only to people who ticked marketing on the early-access form.

draft.title: Launch message draft
draft.body: The system never sends this. On launch day it appears here as a notification and is emailed to you, and you send it yourself.

audience.title: Early-access list ({{count}})
audience.showAll: Show people who have signed up
audience.note: One-tap links open WhatsApp or your SMS app with the message filled in. Only people who opted in to marketing get links; the rest are email only.
audience.notOptedIn: Did not opt in to marketing
audience.badPhone: No usable South African number. Check it by hand.

rewards.error: Something went wrong. Check the values and try again.

settings.title: Switches
settings.body: Everything is off until you turn it on. Rules and rewards below are proposals you can edit first.
settings.points_enabledHint: Master switch. Nothing is awarded and referrals stay pending while it is off.
settings.rewards_enabledHint: Shows the catalogue and allows redemption of active rewards.
settings.betting_vouchers_enabledHint: A gambling promotion. Keep off until counsel signs off and a licensed partner funds them. Only 18+, email-confirmed members see them.

rules.title: Earning rules
rules.body: Points reward activity, never results. A blank cap means no cap. Each rule needs its own Active tick.

catalogue.title: Rewards catalogue
catalogue.body: New rewards start inactive. Voucher rewards use the codes you upload; others use a stock number or no limit.
catalogue.name: Name

adjust.title: Adjust points
adjust.body: Written as a new ledger row with your name and reason. It never edits an earlier row.
adjust.negative: That would take the balance below zero.

referrals.title: Referral review
referrals.body: Recent invites. A flag means one member qualified several friends within an hour.
